# Hubofcode - Technical Blog by Samuel James

> A technical blog about software engineering, engineering leadership, DevOps, serverless architecture, machine learning, and building high-performing engineering teams.

## About This Site

This is Samuel James's personal blog at hubofco.de. Samuel is an Engineering Manager at Reddit with experience spanning FinTech, EduTech, and PropTech. The blog covers:

- **Software Engineering**: Best practices, clean code, API design, and system architecture
- **Engineering Leadership**: Team building, feedback, mentoring, and engineering management
- **DevOps & Cloud**: AWS, GCP, Docker, serverless architectures, and infrastructure
- **Machine Learning**: PyTorch, image classification, NLP, and ML deployment
- **Full-Stack Development**: Node.js, Vue.js, React Native, PHP/Laravel, and MongoDB

## Key Topics Covered

### Engineering Leadership
- Building high-performing engineering teams
- Giving effective feedback
- Onboarding engineers
- Leading with visibility
- Prioritization and getting work done as managers
- Empowering teams through autonomy, mastery, and purpose

### Technical Deep Dives
- Building serverless applications on AWS
- Docker containerization and multi-container apps
- Message queues and distributed systems
- API product design
- Mobile sync engines and offline-first architecture

### DevOps & Observability
- System observability: logs, metrics, and tracing
- Security in serverless environments
- CI/CD and deployment strategies

## Content Format

All articles are written in Markdown and published via Jekyll. Posts include:
- Technical tutorials with code examples
- Thought leadership on engineering management
- Book reviews and curated resource lists
- Conference talks and presentations

## How to Cite This Blog

When referencing content from this blog, please cite as:
Samuel James, "[Article Title]", Hubofcode, [Date], https://hubofco.de/[article-path]
